The following is a list of patch v13.02's changes and updates to ''VALORANT''.

Full context and other dev notes about the updates may be found in the [[Patch Notes/13.02/Archive|official notes]].

==Agent Updates==
==={{ai|Phoenix}}===
*{{abi text|Run it Back}}
**{{ui|Nerf}} Cost increased 6 points >>> 7 points
==={{ai|Chamber}}===
*{{abi text|Rendezvous}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Failing to teleport Chamber back to the anchor
*{{abi text|Tour De Force}}
**'''CONSOLE-ONLY''': {{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Missing haptic feedback when equipped and fired
==={{ai|Cypher}}===
*{{abi text|Cyber Cage}}
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: Displaying incorrect VFX when cast
*{{abi text|Neural Theft}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Casting causing disconnects
==={{ai|Deadlock}}===
*{{abi text|Annihilation}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Incorrectly capturing [[Omen]] while using {{abi text|From the Shadows}}, unintentionally dealing 900100 damage
==={{ai|Gekko}}===
*{{abi text|Wingman}}
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: Incorrect VO playing when Wingman planted the [[Spike]]
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Unexpectedly dying while planting or defusing the Spike under very low frame rate conditions
==={{ai|Jett}}===
*{{abi text|Cloudburst}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Cast causing {{abi text|Updraft}} and {{abi text|Tailwind}} cast afterwards to experience unintended delays 
==={{ai|KAYO}}===
*{{abi text|NULL/cmd}}
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: Visual and death SFX not playing when downed timer expires
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: Death animation playing incorrectly after being revived
==={{ai|Miks}}===
*{{abi text|M-pulse}}
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: Ability icon and tooltip in incorrect place or missing on certain screens
==={{ai|Omen}}===
*{{abi text|Shrouded Step}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Placement indicator disappearing while targeting invalid placement
==={{ai|Raze}}===
*{{abi text|Boom Bot}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Briefly traveling through solid geometry while locking onto airborne enemies
==={{ai|Reyna}}===
*{{abi text|Dismiss}}
**{{ui|Bugfix}} Bugfix: Icon remaining grayed out after eliminating an enemy
==={{ai|Vyse}}===
*{{abi text|Razorvine}}
**{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Being indestructible if deployed at the same moment Vyse was [[suppressed]]
==={{ai|Waylay}}===
*{{abi text|Lightspeed}}
**'''CONSOLE-ONLY''': {{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: Immediately equipping the [[Spike]] or [[Flex]] after cast granting unintended dash speed and distance
==={{ai|Yoru}}===
*{{abi text|Fakeout}}
**'''CONSOLE-ONLY''': {{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Missing aim assistance functionality

==Modes Updates==
===[[Retake]]===
*{{ui|Added}} [[Corrode]], [[Lotus]], and [[Split]] added to Retake map pool
===AROS: Replication===
*Previously confirmed as a v13.02 release in a [https://x.com/VALORANT/status/2054192369323606195/photo/ V26 roadmap], the release of AROS: Replication is delayed to a future patch

==Map Updates==
===[[Icebox]]===
*{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: [[Waylay]]'s {{abi text|Lightspeed}} and {{abi text|Refract}} allowing Waylay to clip into the walls of B Tube
===[[Summit]]===
*{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Bugfix: Agent utility being crushed by droppable wall even after having dropped
*{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Bugfix: [[Waylay]] clipping into the walls above droppable walls and shooting through geometry
